title.zh: 生成式项目如何可复查：版本、提示词与证据链
title.en: Making generative projects reviewable: versions, prompts and evidence

summary.zh: 把模型版本、权重来源、提示词、参数、运行环境和失败案例放进一份可复查记录。
summary.en: Record model revisions, checkpoint provenance, prompts, parameters, runtime environment and failure cases in a reviewable manifest.

basis.zh: 这是面向文生图、数字人和多模态生成的工程化学习模板。它提出记录字段和复查步骤，不代表个人项目已经应用该模板或获得实验结果。
basis.en: An engineering study template for text-to-image, digital-human and multimodal generation. It proposes record fields and review steps; it does not claim that the template has been used in a personal project or produced experimental results.

title.zh: 01 / 为什么“同一模型名”不够
title.en: 01 / Why a model name alone is not enough

paragraphs.zh: 同一个模型仓库可能更新配置、权重或依赖；相同提示词也可能因预处理、scheduler、seed、精度、采样参数和软件栈变化而产生不同结果。一次推理要可复查，至少需要回答：运行了什么版本、输入是什么、用了哪些参数、输出如何检查、他人怎样在许可范围内重做。
paragraphs.en: A model repository can update configs, weights or dependencies; the same prompt can yield different outputs when preprocessing, scheduler, seed, precision, sampling parameters or software stack changes. A reviewable inference should answer: Which version ran? What were the inputs and parameters? How was the output checked? How can someone reproduce it within the applicable license?

paragraphs.zh: 推荐把“方法说明、运行记录、结果与限制”分开写。教程示例不等于真实用户研究或性能证据；合成图片和视频也不能代替数据集、基线、消融或统计分析。
paragraphs.en: Keep method notes, run records, outputs and limitations distinct. A tutorial example is not user-study or performance evidence; synthetic images and videos do not replace datasets, baselines, ablations or statistical analysis.

paragraphs.zh: 模型字段记录仓库名、revision 或 commit、权重来源及可公开的校验值；输入字段记录提示词、素材来源摘要和预处理；运行字段记录代码版本、Python/PyTorch/CUDA、硬件、scheduler、步数、guidance、分辨率和 seed；结果字段记录输出路径、人工检查项、失败样例与限制。涉及私人素材时只留最小化的内部标识或哈希，不要公开人脸、语音或访问凭据。
paragraphs.en: Record repository ID, revision or commit, checkpoint provenance and a shareable checksum. Capture the prompt, a source summary and preprocessing. Log code version, Python/PyTorch/CUDA, hardware, scheduler, steps, guidance, resolution and seed. Track output path, human-review checks, failure cases and limitations. For private media, retain only a minimal internal identifier or hash; do not publish faces, voices or credentials.

paragraphs.zh: 公开展示前，逐项核对素材和模型许可、个人信息与肖像授权、权重是否可再分发、生成内容是否标注、提示词和示例数据是否泄露隐私、链接是否可访问。若许可证不允许上传权重，只公开代码、配置说明、校验值和合规样例；敏感素材保留在本地。
paragraphs.en: Before publishing, check media and model licenses, personal data and likeness consent, checkpoint redistribution terms, synthetic-content disclosure, privacy leakage in prompts or sample data, and link accessibility. If checkpoint redistribution is not permitted, publish code, configuration notes, checksums and compliant samples only; keep sensitive media local.

bullets.zh: 能否在不暴露私密素材的前提下说明输入和处理步骤？
bullets.en: Can the inputs and processing be described without exposing private media?

bullets.zh: 读者能否区分真实项目代码、教学示例和计划中的实验？
bullets.en: Can readers distinguish project code, instructional examples and proposed experiments?

bullets.zh: 是否保留负面结果、失败样例和适用范围，而不只挑选最好看的输出？
bullets.en: Are negative results, failures and scope retained instead of showing only the best-looking output?

callout.zh: 清晰标注“已运行”“教学示例”“待验证”，并为每项结论附上读者可以检查的来源或记录。
callout.en: Label material clearly as “run,” “instructional example” or “unverified,” and attach a checkable source or record to each claim.
